money_equations.C_o: Σ owner remaining entry notional and cost memo commitments. At the lawful fee-visibility transition, release only the matching fee-cover component once; retain unACKed entry notional. Surplus exit buffer remains until ExitAck.
money_equations.E_c: CASH + U_ack_live + Σ min(0, U_unack_live) - Σ visible unpaid TRADE_PAYABLE per exit slice - Σ visible unpaid FEE_PAYABLE per fee item. Exclude every unACKed TRADE_RECEIVABLE independently; do not net opposite slices or gross gains against fees. On lawful exit visibility, remove its open MTM before adding realized payable.
money_equations.E_d: Settled CASH + acknowledged live-position MTM at last available mark; no report-plane values.
money_equations.E_r: E_c - P_f, where only causally FINAL unpaid funding is risk expense. Unfinalized conditional exposure stays in admission reserves.
money_equations.L_f: Σ owner max(0, required conditional/final cover - dedicated cover). Each shortfall has owner/settlement ID.
money_equations.P_f: Σ owner FINAL unpaid FUNDING_PAYABLE. Conditional exposure is reserved separately until causal finalization.
money_equations.R_f: Σ owner future/conditional funding reserve + reserved cover for unpaid funding; include closed, unsettled owners.
money_equations.asset_budget: B = max(0, min(333.333333333333, A/3, A-G)). Use one prior snapshot and canonical BTC/ETH/SOL sequential commitments; pending entry notional remains committed until FillAck.
money_equations.cash_reconciliation: CASH-CASH0 = settled effective gross PnL - settled entry fees - settled exit fees - settled funding + authorized itemized flows. At flat/all-ACK terminal this equals Σ final trade net PnL + flows, without residual payables or reserves.
money_equations.economic_equity: Report-only CASH + true open unrealized PnL + TRADE_RECEIVABLE - TRADE_PAYABLE - FEE_PAYABLE - FUNDING_PAYABLE; economic accruals are dated by event time, but cannot backfill decision history.
money_equations.free_before_kill: A = 0 if killed or insolvent else max(0, A_raw). Assert the untruncated upper bound only when A_raw >= 0. This floor applies to new spending, never to CASH or economic losses.
money_equations.funding_encumbrance_union: R_f + L_f = R_future + Σ max(R_covered, P_owner_or_conditional_required). Cover and its payable are the same obligation; do not add P_f again to admission.
money_equations.risk_and_buffer_caveat: The 5% admission buffer is applied to conservative trade-capital E_c; funding is deducted once through the cover/shortfall union. E_r also reflects FINAL funding for the 100-USDT risk kill. AM02 must explicitly bind these distinct projections before implementation.
